description: This file implements classes and functions for handling Linux Netlink socket communication, including serialization, deserialization, sending, receiving, and managing Netlink messages within the WPEFramework Core namespace.

classes.name: Netlink
classes.description: Represents a Netlink message with methods for serialization and deserialization, managing message headers, types, and sequences.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the Netlink object into a byte stream suitable for socket transmission.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a byte stream into the Netlink object, extracting message type, flags, and sequence.

classes.name: SocketNetlink
classes.description: Implements Netlink socket communication, managing message queues, sending, receiving, and synchronization.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Sends a Netlink message over the socket with optional wait time.

methods.name: Exchange
methods.description: Performs a send and receive operation atomically over the socket.

methods.name: SendData
methods.description: Prepares the next pending message for sending.

methods.name: ReceiveData
methods.description: Processes received data frames, matching responses to pending requests.

methods.name: StateChange
methods.description: Handles signaling state changes such as connection open or close.
